text: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊9月10日在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上表示，近日，《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》正式出台。为实施好相关部署，中国人民银行制定印发了《中国人民银行“十五五”改革发展规划》，配套出台了9份相关领域的行动方案。（新华社）
text_en: Lu Lei, deputy governor of the People's Bank of China, said at the State Council Information Office's themed press conference series on "Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan" held on September 10 that the "15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Power" was officially issued recently. To implement the relevant arrangements, the People's Bank of China formulated and issued the "People's Bank of China 15th Five-Year Plan for Reform and Development," and introduced nine supporting action plans in related fields. (Xinhua News Agency)
